messages:
PetraHealth - PM: Hey team — we'd like to onboard a custom 'discharge note' summarizer for our care ops. Key asks: PHI-aware redaction, customer HSM for keys, dedicated capacity with predictable latency, and a safety/eval pass before renewal in ~6 weeks. Spec: https://petrahealth.example.com/specs/discharge-summarizer

Sana - CSM: Thanks! Can you confirm expected QPS and SLOs? I'll loop in Eng and Security and set a kickoff.

PetraHealth - PM: Peak ~15 QPS, typical 4 QPS. Targets: p50 <= 250ms, p95 <= 800ms. Throughput prioritized over cost. Also want canary and automated rollback on quality regressions.

Jared - Solutions Eng: Quick clarifying q's —
- sample size for eval? (we prefer 200-500 annotated examples)
- language variants?
- streaming vs full-response?

PetraHealth - PM: We'll provide ~400 de-id examples + 100 annotated PHI edge cases. English only. Full-response is fine (no streaming).

Priya - Security SME: Checklist from security: please confirm —
- customer-managed KMS/HSM integration (y/n)
- data retention for logs/prompts
- audit log export cadence
- VPC-only egress / in-flight encryption

PetraHealth - PM: Yes to HSM (YubiHSM attestation). Logs retained 90 days, export daily. VPC-only egress required.

Jared - Solutions Eng: Proposed starter deployment (please confirm values):
```yaml
model: redwood-13b-phi-safe
deployment: dedicated-d32
routing: latency-first
batching: auto
kms: customer-hsm://petra-prod
canary: 5% traffic for 48h
```

Sana - CSM: I'll draft the scope + timeline. Proposed: kickoff & data handoff this week; safety eval + offline metrics 2 weeks; private deploy + canary week 3; prod cutover after rollback window week 4. Renewal in ~6w — tight but doable if handoff happens today.

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-4321 created for PetraHealth onboarding. Assignees: Sana, Jared, Priya.

Sana - CSM: Action items for PetraHealth:
1) Upload 400 samples to S3 with read-only role for redwood-cs-onboard@redwood-inference
2) Provide HSM attestation docs + key rotation contact
3) Share an hourly traffic trace for 7 days

PetraHealth - PM: Uploading samples now -> s3://petra-onboard/2026-03-discharge-samples. HSM contact devops@petrahealth.com. Also adding a short traffic trace.

Priya - Security SME: Once S3 samples available we'll run a privacy scan and request a short consent attestation. I'll draft the audit-log retention/export spec.

Jared - Solutions Eng: I'll spin up an eval harness against the 400 samples and post preliminary metrics here. If latency looks good, I'll provision an 8xA10G canary pool to start.

PetraHealth - PM: One more: can we include a fallback to an on-prem rule-based summarizer if model p95 > 1s? Want to avoid user-facing timeouts.

Jared - Solutions Eng: Yep — we can add routing fallback to a lightweight rules service and wire it into the rollout plan.

Sana - CSM: Noted. I'll update the scope doc and send invites for kickoff + mid-eval checkpoint.

PetraHealth - PM: Please flag any renewal risk items to our AM if timeline slips.

accounts - AM: Heard — will monitor. If compute procurement needs to be accelerated we can escalate on our side.

Jared - Solutions Eng: Internal note: aiming for dedicated 8xA10G for canary to meet p95. Will post perf numbers tomorrow.

Sana - CSM: Closing checklist for now: data link received, HSM contact provided, ticket created. Kickoff in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
